senses.gloss: शीधु &c. See सीधु.
सीधु m. (L. also f. and n.; less correctly शीधु, of unknown derivation) spirituous liquor distilled from molasses, rum (or any similar spirit, also fig. = ‘nectar’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
1. सिध् cl. 1. P. सेधति, to go, move, Dhātup. iii, 10; Naigh. ii, 14 (accord. to Pāṇ. viii, 3, 113 the स् of this root is not changed to ष् after prepositions; cf. अभि- and परि-√ सिध्).
1. सिध्म॑ mfn. (for 2. See p. 1217, col. 1) going straight to a goal or object aimed at, RV. i, 33, 13.
2. सिध्म॑ mf(आ)n. (of doubtful derivation) white-spotted (accord. to others ‘leprous’), TS.
सिध्म॑ m. n. one of the 18 forms of leprosy (= महाकुष्ठ), Car.; Bhpr.
सिध्म॑ n. a blotch, scab, W.
3. सिध्म in comp. for सिध्मन्.
सिध्मा (आ), f. a blotch, leprous spot, MW.
leprosy, ib.
सिध्य m. ‘auspicious’, N. of the asterism Puṣya, L.
सिध्र॑ mf(आ॑)n. = 1. सिध्म॑, RV.
successful, efficacious, ib.
perfect, good, Uṇ. ii, 13, Sch.
सिध्र॑ m. a kind of tree, ib.
सीध्र n. the anus, L.
सिध्रक m. a kind of tree, KātyŚr.
सिध्रका in comp. for सिध्रक.
सिध्रका—वण n. (cf. g. कोटरादि) N. of one of the celestial gardens, L.
सिध्रका—वत् See सैध्रकावत.
सिध्म—पुष्पिका f. a kind of mild leprosy, L.
सिध्म—वत् mfn. leprous, Pāṇ. v, 2, 97
blotchy, pock-marked, W.
सिध्मन् m. n. one of the 18 varieties of leprosy (= क्षुद्र-कुष्ठ), Suśr.; MBh. &c.
सिध्मल॑ mfn. leprous, TBr.; Pāṇ. v, 2, 97
सिध्मला (आ), f. a kind of leprosy, Col.
dried or salt fish, L.
सीधु—गन्ध m. ‘having the smell of rum or spirituous liquor’, the plant or tree Mimusops Elengi (= बकुल), L.
सीधु—प mf(आ, or ई)n. drinking spirits, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 8, Vārtt. 1.
सीधु—पान n. the drinking of spirits, MBh.
सीधु—पुष्प m. the Bakula tree, L.
the Kadamba tree, L.
सीधु—पुष्पी (ई), f. Grislea Tomentosa (v.l. स्वादु-प्˚), L.
सीधु—रस m. ‘having juice like spirituous liquor’, the Mango tree, L.
सीधु—संज्ञ m. the Bakula tree, L.
